lines.cap: This bull has balls of steel. And he can't even see red.
lines.say: This bull has balls of steel. And he can't even see red.

lines.cap: For centuries, bullfighters have waved a red cape at angry bulls.
lines.say: For centuries, bullfighters have waved a red cape at angry bulls.

lines.cap: But cattle see in only two main colours. To a bull, red looks dull and greyish.
lines.say: But cattle see in only two main colours. To a bull, red looks dull and greyish.

lines.cap: In tests with red, blue and white flags, the bull charged whichever one was moving.
lines.say: In tests with red, blue and white flags, the bull charged whichever one was moving.

lines.cap: What sets him off is the movement. A cape that snaps and swirls.
lines.say: What sets him off is the movement. A cape that snaps and swirls.

lines.cap: In one famous test, a bull ignored a man standing perfectly still, and charged the one waving his arms.
lines.say: In one famous test, a bull ignored a man standing perfectly still, and charged the one waving his arms.

lines.cap: So why red? Tradition. And it hides the blood.
lines.say: So why red? Tradition. And it hides the blood.

lines.cap: It was never the colour. It's the attitude.
lines.say: It was never the colour. It's the attitude.
